items.headline: Stocks edge higher Wednesday as the Fed holds; Big Tech earnings come after the close
items.note: The Dow rose roughly 0.2% (to about 52,475), the S&P 500 about 0.3% and the Nasdaq almost 0.3%. Microsoft and Alphabet reported after the bell, and Nasdaq futures dipped Thursday as investors weighed the mixed results against heavy AI spending.

items.headline: Fed holds at 3.75%-4% in a 10-2 vote, with two officials wanting a hike
items.note: Cleveland Fed's Beth Hammack and Governor Lisa Cook dissented in favor of raising rates. Chair Kevin Warsh also said the Fed will keep eight meetings a year but make one 2027 meeting strategy-only, with no rate vote. One report says markets price about an 85% chance of a December hike, which would matter for tech hiring budgets.

items.headline: Microsoft posts $92.3B quarterly revenue; about $10B came from OpenAI
items.note: TechCrunch says that is nearly 11% of Microsoft's quarter, and OpenAI owed it $7.2B at the end of September. Microsoft also disclosed Azure revenue of $33.2B. It shows how much of the AI boom rests on a few big customer relationships.

items.headline: Alphabet misses estimates and drops after hours on AI-spending worries
items.note: Third-quarter adjusted EPS was $2.67 versus $3.02 expected, and revenue of $127.58B also fell short. Reports of the after-hours drop run to about 10%. Investors are asking when huge AI spending turns into profit.

items.headline: Anthropic launches 'Smart Reports' to show what a company's AI spending buys
items.note: The tools show managers what teams produced, what it cost and where workflows broke down, plus pooled token budgets. Investor figures cited include an operating profit in Q2. Measuring AI's return on investment is becoming a real analytics job.

items.headline: Microsoft's reported buyout offers to about 60,000 employees still shape the job market
items.note: Reports say the offers go to select teams. Big firms are trimming headcount while spending on AI, so aim for teams that are visibly growing.

items.headline: Cloud security startup Upwind raises $400M after turning down a Datadog offer
items.note: The headline says it walked away from an acquisition offer from Datadog. Security data is a big area for applied ML hiring.

items.headline: Nvidia releases a new open transcription model as voice AI heats up
items.note: TechCrunch covers the open model release as part of a wider push into voice AI. Open models are easy to try yourself for a portfolio project.

items.headline: Apple launches a touchscreen MacBook Pro
items.note: TechCrunch says the launch also pushes laptop pricing to a new extreme. Worth knowing before you buy a machine for ML coursework.

learn.explain: Hawkish describes a central banker who worries most about inflation and favors higher interest rates. Dovish describes one who worries most about weak jobs and growth and favors lower rates. Each Fed meeting ends in a vote, and a dissent is a no vote against the majority. Today the Fed held rates 10-2, and both dissenters, Beth Hammack and Lisa Cook, wanted a hike, which is a hawkish signal. Traders read dissents as clues about where rates may go next.
